title: Alleged Assassination Plots Involving Foreign Leaders (Church Committee Interim Report)
authors: United States Senate Select Committee to Study Governmental Operations with Respect to Intelligence Activities
publisher_or_archive: United States Senate / 94th Congress, 1st Session, Report No. 94-465
summary: Landmark US Senate investigation exposing covert CIA plots to assassinate foreign leaders, detailing CIA Director Allen Dulles's cables ordering Lumumba's removal as an 'urgent and prime objective,' the dispatch of CIA toxicologist Sydney Gottlieb with biological poisons, and CIA complicity in plots targeting Ngo Dinh Diem, Rafael Trujillo, and Fidel Castro.
